scope: Read-only source audit of original uploaded ZIP, followed by the specified content-builder repair. Does not establish live Google indexing reasons.

original_measurements.similarity_method: difflib.SequenceMatcher with autojunk=False across section titles and content; matched S01 city records, then replaced Delhi and Mumbai with the same city token.

findings.finding: Canonical, Open Graph and schema URLs hard-code singular erfreelancer.com; confirm against live hostname. Every HTML shell begins with the homepage canonical; client code later changes it.

Sitemap advertises service hubs, geography hubs and core URLs that original client routing does not implement. Unknown/non-location routes fall back to homepage and push homepage URL instead of serving a meaningful page or 404.
Disallow /api blocks resources required for client-rendered public content. Original HTML has no rendered primary content.
2,719 generated sector/zone pattern locations are marked verified without source evidence. Country/city timezone shortcuts include Perth and Brisbane using Australia/Sydney.

All 144 seed profiles are approved, including an explicitly named staging test specialist and repetitive generated global profiles. Identity badges, real project markers and qualification claims need actual evidence; seed labels are not evidence.

Static aggregateRating 5.0 with 1,500 reviewCount, unsupported testimonial metrics and ProfessionalService addresses at target locations misrepresent evidence or physical presence unless separately substantiated.

Original builder assigns qualityScore 98, passed review, approved lifecycle and published time automatically. Fetching a candidate route generates the page. Repeated location-name substitution does not establish useful independent content.

Sitemap blindly publishes the Cartesian matrix, fixed at 50,400 although 3,643 x 14 equals 51,002 candidate combinations. Lastmod is today on every request rather than actual change time; Google ping URL is obsolete.
Main discovery actions are buttons instead of crawlable href links. Stored internal_link_ids do not measure actual inbound navigation links.
Location pages keep global homepage description and Open Graph metadata. The generated package metadata is not fully applied by original client code.
Published blog posts are omitted from sitemap. Blog pagination is in component state rather than crawlable paginated URLs; failed slugs keep an HTML success shell.
Completion report invents zero HTTP/SEO failures and treats generated count as HTTP-tested count. SEO audit is only string lengths and FAQ existence with several always-true fields.
Founder is named Rajeev Sharma in archive despite user identity Rajeev Kumar. Base location is unconfirmed in facts but Laxmi Nagar office/residency claims occur in public content.
Search Console feature is a manual checklist, not an authenticated integration. Exact Page Indexing exclusion reasons and URL Inspection results remain unknown.

content_builder_repair.new_pages: needs_review; indexable false; review pending; publishedAt null; qualityAssessment not_scored; numeric qualityScore 0 retained for legacy interface
content_builder_repair.content: Distinct practical guidance for all 14 service categories; scope options, project questions, exclusions, pricing factors, acceptance checks and qualified timezone scheduling.
content_builder_repair.availability: Approved service matches only, no unavailable/waitlist/test profiles; remote countries respect country_remote coverage; onsite requires explicitly listed area; no-match stays empty.
content_builder_repair.limitation: This remains a reusable draft template. It intentionally does not claim independent local value or approve/index the matrix. Existing stored pages require parent-managed migration and public delivery safeguards.
content_builder_repair.regression_checks: Four content integrity regression functions passed by direct Python execution. pytest is not installed in this runtime.
